articles.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

articles.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
articles.snippet: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

articles.title: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
articles.snippet: As geopolitical and technological threats multiply, the big question is whether you can hold on to your wealth and access funds when the system fails.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Says He'd Be 'Honored' to Return as Nvidia CEO, Despite Board's Resistance
articles.snippet: The ousted Nvidia founder apologized for his conduct, offered to return if directors ask, and addressed supporters as the chipmaker presses ahead with its search for new leadership this week.
